LIHW.original_behavior: UNRESOLVED - the MDL simply declares no e-frame for LIHW:static; the engine-side handling of an absent frame slot was not recovered from the binary
LIHW.compatibility_rule: deterministic nearest: when the quantizer selects slot e (0deg view-relative), use the w frame (same wall diagonal, opposite face). Flag as non-original.

ASID.compatibility_rule: deterministic nearest: when the quantizer selects slot s (90deg), use se (adjacent facet at 45deg, lower angle). Flag as non-original.
